instruction: Using Obsidian, append the line "- ask whether the API limits changed" at the end of the note "Meetings/Partner Agenda.md".

command:
content=$(printf '%b' '# Partner Agenda

- timeline review
- resourcing check
'); obsidian-cli create "Meetings/Partner Agenda.md" --content "$content" --overwrite --vault "Benchmark"

reference_command: content=$(printf '%b' '- ask whether the API limits changed'); obsidian-cli create "Meetings/Partner Agenda.md" --content "$content" --append --vault "Benchmark"

expected_texts: - ask whether the API limits changed
